gizmo.title: Ndetu ala ala
gizmo.description: Ndetu e dere ebe ọ dabara n'ederede. Ọ na-egosi dịka ọnụọgụ, ndepụta ndetu nwere nọmba na-ewukwa onwe ya n'ala peeji.

configure.title: Enweghị nlele mbụ
configure.description: Egosila ndetu ahụ mgbe onye na-agụ akwụkwọ dọrọ mmasị n'elu ma ọ bụ lekwasị anya na ọnụọgụ ahụ.
